verses: I also saw the souls of a man and a woman whose tongues were put out, and ever gnawed by the jaws of serpents.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by the body of these? and who are those souls?'
Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'These are the souls of that wicked who, in the world, ever committed slander, and embroiled people together.'
